newsitem.title: LUXEMBOURG: SOCCER-JEUNESSE ESCH COMPLETE LUXEMBOURG DOUBLE.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-JEUNESSE ESCH COMPLETE LUXEMBOURG DOUBLE.

text.p: Jeunesse Esch completed the Luxembourg league and cup double on Saturday with a 2-0 Cup final win over Union Luxembourg.
Dany Theis opened the scoring in the 37th minute and fellow Luxembourg international Patrick Morocutti made it 2-0 in the 59th from a Paulo Amodio cross from the left.
It was Jeunesse's 10th Cup win and their seventh double.
